accueil.title: Welcome
accueil.lead: Sports coach, life coach and yoga teacher — I support you with kindness toward more energy, clarity and confidence.
accueil.approachText: Every programme is tailored: we clarify your goals, move at your pace, and work on body, mind and daily habits. I do not provide medical care — I guide and motivate you.
accueil.testimonialsTeaser: Trust is built over time — here are a few words from people I have coached.
accueil.servicesText: Three complementary approaches — fitness, yoga and life coaching — for lasting balance.
accueil.heroTitle:

accueil.aboutSectionHeading: A passion, a journey, a calling
accueil.aboutSectionParagraph1: A former dancer at the Lido de Paris, I worked in a demanding world where body, discipline and self-confidence were at the heart of every performance.
accueil.aboutSectionParagraph2: Today I put that unique experience at the service of your well-being, supporting you with kindness and energy through your own transformation.
accueil.aboutSectionQuote: Movement is a source of life, for both body and mind.
accueil.aboutImageAlt: Alicia Semenchuk, sports, yoga and life coach.
accueil.service1Text: Programmes adapted to your level: mobility, strength, endurance and recovery, in person or online.
accueil.service2Text: Gentle to dynamic yoga: breath, alignment and grounding, for all levels.
accueil.service3Text: A listening space to clarify priorities, move past blocks and take action.

about.title: About
about.lead: Former dancer at the Lido de Paris, I now bring discipline and body awareness into warm, motivating coaching.
about.whoText: I am Alicia Semenchuk, sports coach, life coach and yoga teacher. My artistic background taught me discipline, body awareness and stage confidence; I use that to support you in personal or professional life with kindness and positive energy.
about.methodText: We start with a conversation to understand your situation and goals. Sessions are usually 60 minutes, in person (Paris area) or online. Between sessions, short exercises or reflections may be suggested. I do not make medical diagnoses — please see a healthcare professional when needed.
about.forWhoText: Individuals in transition, seeking balance or fitness; amateur athletes; anyone wanting yoga or coaching in daily life. Companies can contact me for wellness workshops or team-building (quote on request).

accomplishments.title: Coaching services
accomplishments.intro: Whether you want more energy, focus or clarity on a life project, I offer tailored support.
accomplishments.service1Detail: Individual sports coaching: fitness check, measurable goals (flexibility, strength, return to activity), progressive sessions. Ideal after a break or for a personal target. Minimal equipment; beginners and intermediate welcome.
accomplishments.service2Detail: Yoga: accessible flows, breath and alignment. Hybrid style inspired by Hatha and gentle flow. Small group or one-to-one; mat provided in person.
accomplishments.service3Detail: Life coaching: common themes — confidence, organisation, work-life balance, action. Kind, structured framework; number of sessions agreed together (often 4–8 for a first cycle).

journey.title: My journey
journey.intro: From the Lido stage to one-to-one coaching: movement, body and sharing remain the thread.
journey.trainingText: Life coaching and support training (institutions and dates to be specified). Yoga and physical preparation certifications (details to complete). Ongoing learning in teaching, active listening and safe exercise.
journey.experienceText: Professional dancer at the Lido de Paris for several years: rigour, endurance and teamwork. Gradual shift toward coaching and yoga, with private clients and wellness workshops.
journey.todayText: I coach clients in person and online, in French (and in English or Russian on request). I also prepare corporate workshops and keep training to offer demanding yet kind support.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a1: Click “Book an appointment” in the menu or go to the booking page and choose a slot on Calendly. An online link is sent for remote sessions.
faq.q2: Are sessions in person or online?
faq.a2: Both, depending on your situation. In person in the Paris area (venue confirmed when booking). Online via the link sent after booking (Zoom through Calendly).
faq.q3: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a3Prefix: Bank transfer, cash in person, or secure payment link (coming soon). See also the
faq.q5: Do you offer a free discovery call?
faq.a5: A short 15–20 minute discovery call may be available depending on slots — contact me or book a “discovery” slot on Calendly if open.
